purpose: Diagnose whether the V12 H1-to-H2 return collapse is accompanied by signal-time covariate/composition drift under the stable V17 representation.

cohorts.h1: 2025-03-01 through 2025-06-30 V12 events; prior-day gates; all V17 features finite

metrics: median shift normalized by H1 IQR

decision.stable_signal_time: 0 severe continuous AND <=4 moderate continuous AND no severe trigger flag
decision.partial_shift: 1-2 severe continuous OR >4 moderate continuous, with no severe trigger flag
decision.material_shift: >=3 severe continuous OR any severe trigger flag
decision.interpretation_if_stable: V12 H2 collapse is more consistent with concept drift/missing explanatory state than ordinary covariate drift
decision.interpretation_if_shift: signal-time regime/composition changed materially; further representation/context research may be justified
